# Landlord Studio

> Landlord Studio is a free all-in-one property management platform serving 80,000+ landlords with accounting, rent collection, tenant screening, and maintenance tracking.

Landlord Studio provides comprehensive property management software designed for individual landlords and small-scale investors. The platform offers both free and premium tiers with features spanning financial management, tenant operations, and property maintenance, with specific compliance support for UK landlords including MTD requirements.

## Key Topics

- Property Management
- Rental Accounting
- Tax Reporting
- Rent Collection
- Tenant Screening
- Schedule E
- ACH Payments
- Bank Feeds
- Maintenance Tracking
- Rental Portfolio
- Landlord Studio PRO
- Landlord Studio GO
- Financial Planning
- Tax Deductions
- MTD Compliance

## Core Features

- [Real Estate Accounting Software for Landlords](https://www.landlordstudio.com/features/rental-accounting): Real estate accounting software with expense tracking and tax reporting
- [Advanced Financial Reporting for Landlords](https://www.landlordstudio.com/features/tax-reporting): Financial reporting with Schedule E, P&L, and rent ledger reports
- [The Best Online Rent Collection Software](https://www.landlordstudio.com/features/online-rent-collection): Online rent collection with ACH payments and automated tracking
- [Free Tenant Screening Report](https://www.landlordstudio.com/features/tenant-screening): Tenant screening with credit, background, and eviction checks
- [Property Maintenance Management Software](https://www.landlordstudio.com/features/property-maintenance): Property maintenance tracking and task management for landlords
